subject: AIC and p-values do not correspond in pcountOpen

messages.author: badfb066fb6a2eba
messages.subject: AIC and p-values do not correspond in pcountOpen
parts:
Hi everybody,

According to the p-value I get for my model, logging is highly significant here (5.68e-03), but if I then compare this model to my reduced model without logging, the other model without logging is better (AIC with logging is 4533.88 and AIC without logging is 4532.47). Apparently something is wrong here with the specified p-values. Can someone explain why this could be?

Thanks in advance,
Monika

messages.author: e7b13b46bee1b631
messages.subject: Re: AIC and p-values do not correspond in pcountOpen
parts: Perhaps neither model fits the data particularly well. AIC compares models not data fit. Is it possible to have a poor fit and a 'significant' p-value with your data?
